input.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: Vendor IP indemnity covering Customer and Affiliates (20.1), plus indemnities for breach of law, bodily injury/property damage, Customer Data breach caused by Vendor, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud (20.2). Customer's indemnity is narrow (Customer-supplied material and Customer's unlawful use, with carve-outs) (20.3), procedure is standard (20.4), and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies are in addition to defence (20.5). Indemnities sit outside the liability cap as Excluded Claims (21.3).

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us; 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire or sell any product and to operate in any field or territory. The only competitive covenant (12.4) restricts Vendor, which is acceptable and in our favour.
